property.statement: The eight-round AES-256 construction derives the selected u5 byte from k7 but cannot use the AES-192 distant bridge, saving8 guessed bits.
property.quantifier: For the standard AES-256 key schedule in this eight-round construction. The stated saving concerns selected guessed bytes, not an independent master-key entropy count.
property.scope: k7 and u6 are independent consecutive128-bit halves in the AES-256 schedule. Section5.2.3 also explains why an equivalent u_-1 byte is insufficient for the required k_-1 byte.
